one-left.title: Check 1: One digit left
one-left.question: Which digit can go in this empty cell?
one-left.reason: The row already contains every digit except 5. Neither the column nor the box contains 5, so the other two checks agree.

cross-check.title: Check 2: Use the column too
cross-check.question: The row leaves two possibilities. Can the other clues settle the choice?
cross-check.reason: The row is missing 2 and 3. The column already contains 2, so 2 cannot go here. Nothing in the row, column, or box rules out 3.

not-yet.title: Check 3: Know when to wait
not-yet.question: Can you justify a single digit using only these visible digits?
not-yet.answer: Not yet: both 2 and 3 remain candidates.
not-yet.reason: Neither the column nor the box removes either of the two digits missing from the row. These clues alone do not justify choosing one. On a full board, look elsewhere for another certain move and return later.
